meta.description: Golden dataset of high-quality visual-reasoning Q&A pairs for evaluation
meta.verification: 3-run VLM determinism (minimax-m3 sampled reads must ALL match the golden answer) is the machine-verification bar; proved it distinguishes truly answerable questions from plausible-but-ambiguous ones — proven-009 passes, proven-008/010 diverge (16/17 vs 15 and 18/25% vs 20) and are flagged as candidates, not proven
meta.note: proven-001/002/003 are historical entries that now violate the manufactured-difficulty anti-pattern (multi-type counting + sum) and fail current handbook validation — kept for regression reference, flagged via known_issues. proven-004/007 fail current validator rules (extreme-seeking / shallow reasoning) and are historical too.

examples.question: Count all the following elements in this neural network diagram: (1) black rectangular mirrors, (2) standalone gray ellipse lenses, and (3) groups of colored filter bars. Sum all three counts.
examples.reasoning: Multi-type counting + sum. Qwen fails because it must track 3 categories simultaneously across a complex diagram.
known_issues: manufactured difficulty: chained independent counts (now a validator ERROR)

examples.question: How many convolutional filters are shown in the rightmost layer of this CNN architecture diagram? Only count filter groups that contain at least one colored (non-gray) filter.
examples.reasoning: Subjective classification (colored vs gray) + spatial targeting (rightmost layer). Qwen fails on subjective boundary.
known_issues: subjective boundary (colored vs gray) risks non-deterministic answers

examples.question: In this optical computing diagram, count these three types of elements excluding anything inside the blue dashed boxes: (1) black rectangular mirrors, (2) standalone gray ellipse lenses, and (3) groups of colored filter bars. Sum all three counts.
examples.reasoning: Multi-type counting + exclusion (inside dashed boxes). Tests spatial exclusion reasoning.
known_issues: manufactured difficulty: chained independent counts (now a validator ERROR)

examples.question: What is the difference between the maximum bar height in panel A and the maximum bar height in panel B?
examples.reasoning: Read-and-compare across panels. Requires locating peaks in two separate charts and computing difference.

examples.question: How many bars are shown in panel A?
examples.reasoning: Simple observation, single element, no multi-step.

examples.question: What object sits on the surface that is between the plant and the window?
examples.reasoning: Multi-step containment reasoning. Requires identifying a surface, then finding what's on it.

examples.question: Count how many objects are closer to the camera than the red chair.
examples.reasoning: Count across depth planes. Requires judging relative distance for every object in the scene.

examples.question: Sum the number of gesture command rows shown in panel (a) and the number of items shown in the navigation drawer of panel (b), including the footer items.
examples.reasoning: Cross-panel counting + sum. CANDIDATE, not proven: handbook-valid and mimo-v2.5 check-answer matched once, but 3-run determinism diverges (reads 16/17/16 vs 15) — the drawer item count is ambiguous to the vision model.
known_issues: determinism FAIL: sampled minimax-m3 reads 16/17/16 vs golden 15

examples.question: Sum the number of list rows shown in the second, third, and fourth panels of this figure.
examples.reasoning: Multi-panel row counting + sum. PROVEN: handbook-valid, 3-run determinism PASS, fact-check all SUPPORTED, and stored answer matches ground truth (6 + 6 + 2).

examples.question: What is the difference between the sum of the two 'null value' confidence percentages in panel 4 and the sum of the 'text overlap' confidence in panel 2 and the 'missing image' confidence in panel 3?
examples.reasoning: Cross-panel arithmetic over labeled annotations. CANDIDATE, not proven: fact-check all SUPPORTED and the arithmetic is internally consistent (72+98=170 minus 80+70=150), but 3-run determinism diverges (reads 18/25%/18 vs 20) — the model misreads a value.
known_issues: determinism FAIL: sampled minimax-m3 reads 18/25%/18 vs golden 20
